env.name: CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN
env.description: Your Cloudflare Zero Trust team domain, e.g. myteam.cloudflareaccess.com (Zero Trust > Settings > Custom pages / Team domain).

env.name: CF_ACCESS_AUD
env.description: Application Audience (AUD) tag of the Cloudflare Access application that protects this site (Access > Applications > the app > Overview). Several can be given, separated by commas.

env.name: ALLOWED_EMAILS
env.description: Comma-separated email addresses allowed to open the page and approve MCP connections.

env.name: HUB_SECRET
env.description: At least 32 random characters used to sign OAuth tokens (e.g. the output of: openssl rand -hex 32). Changing it disconnects every MCP client.

env.name: OAUTH_REDIRECT_ALLOWLIST
env.description: Comma-separated OAuth redirect URIs MCP clients may register. Leave the default for Claude.

env.name: MCP_ALLOW_LOOPBACK
env.description: Also allow http://localhost/callback and http://127.0.0.1/callback on any port, so Claude Code can connect.
